claims.assertion: Mari says the astral encompasses all existence, while biological senses filter a limited material-world experience within it.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She presents the physical world as an experience shaped by perception.

claims.assertion: She describes lower astral realms as low-frequency and aligned with separation and fear, while higher realms approach Source-like love and integration.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She says entities match realms through compatible vibration.

claims.assertion: Mari says souls inhabit realms matching their perception and can shift frequency through thoughts and interpretation, creating their own heaven or hell.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She says awareness survives bodily death.
